module purpose: neorv32_cpu_icc links CSR accesses to a point-to-point inter-core channel: a CSR write to the data CSR pushes csr_wdata_i into a transmit queue (tx_queue_inst), whose head word and availability leave on icc_tx_o and which the partner's acknowledge (icc_rx_i.ack) pops; CSR reads return a status word (receive-pending bit, transmit-queue free bit) or the partner's data word from icc_rx_i, and a CSR read of the data CSR raises an acknowledge on icc_tx_o.

use-case flows.value: enqueue request: a CSR write that addresses the data CSR decides to push a word into the transmit queue
outgoing message word: csr_wdata_i written into tx_queue_inst, presented to the partner on icc_tx_o.dat with icc_tx_o.rdy, and released by icc_rx_i.ack
incoming message word icc_rx_i.dat returned on csr_rdata_o when the data CSR is addressed and icc_rx_i.rdy is 1, zero otherwise
status word on csr_rdata_o: receive-pending bit (icc_rx_i.rdy) in bit 0 and transmit-queue free bit (tx_fifo_free) in bit 1 when the status CSR is addressed
receive acknowledge to the partner: icc_tx_o.ack raised on a CSR read that addresses the data CSR
